item.title: Randa's Market, Home of the Late KitKat, In Search of New Bodega Cat, Again
item.description: The 16th Street convenience store that lost its resident feline last fall to a tragic accident involving a Waymo is now taking applications for a new bodega cat.

item.title: Emeryville Protesters Storm Home Depot and Target to Pressure Them Against Cooperating With ICE
item.description: Since Home Depot parking lots have become magnets for ICE arrests and deportations, a couple hundred protesters hit the Emeryville Home Depot Tuesday night to pressure the retailer to push back more against ICE.

item.title: Vallejo Rapper LaRussell to Perform at Official NFL Tailgate on Super Bowl Sunday
item.description: Local rapper LaRussell, who petitioned the NFL to let him perform at this year's Bay Area Super Bowl, has gotten the invite to do so at the official NFL Tailgate Party outside Levi's Stadium.

item.title: Gavin Newsom Cancels His Own $250 Million Deal to Save California Newspapers
item.description: Just two years after Gavin Newsom brokered a $250 million deal with Google and Meta for them to help preserve the local newspapers that their business models have destroyed, Newsom himself is now dismantling the deal.

item.title: San Francisco Teachers Could, Maybe, Go On Strike Next Week
item.description: If teachers in the San Francisco Unified School District go on strike next week, amid an impasse with the district over a new contract, it will be the first time in 47 years that this has happened — which, one could say, suggests a resolution to the impasse is still likely to come.

item.title: Videos Show Capture of Mountain Lion Who Went Wandering Around Pacific Heights, and His Release to the Wild
item.description: That two-year-old male mountain lion who wandered up from the Peninsula and ended up scaring dozens of people around Pacific Heights on Monday has been released back to the wild, way down in the Santa Cruz Mountains.

item.title: SF Hosts Governor's Race Debate This Tuesday Night, at Bayview Opera House
item.description: There’s just five months until we choose who will be the next California governor (or at least, have the primary election for that office), and six major candidates will be duking it out Tuesday night here in SF in a debate.

item.title: Amid Declining Sales, Tesla to Convert Fremont Plant Into Robot Factory
item.description: Elon Musk made a big announcement about Tesla on Wednesday, saying in an earnings call that the company would be ending production of its Model S and Model X, and converting the Fremont factory to production of the Optimus robot.

item.title: Sup. Dorsey’s Latest Crusade Is to Hold Hearings Into Whether SF Drug Court Is Getting Too Lenient
item.description: SF’s 30-year-old Drug Court was intended for non-violent drug offenders to avoid jail for low-level drug crimes. But now people with pretty violent charges are sneaking in, and Supervisor Matt Dorsey ain’t happy about it.

item.title: Day Around the Bay: East Bay High Schoolers Stage Anti-ICE Walkout
item.description: East Bay high school students protested ICE actions with a walkout this morning; San Ramon's Bishop Ranch will see some major housing development; and a judge in Minnesota has condemned ICE for violating court orders.
